19.description: The Saskatoon Environmental Advisory Committee appointed Angela Spence as Chair and Manvi Ghai as Vice-Chair for 2026.

23.description: Saskatoon's Environmental Grant Program, which funds local environmental initiatives, will have a new committee member to help review applications.

chips.text: Councillor Robin nominated Christa to serve on the grant adjudication committee.
Environmental groups in Saskatoon receive funding from the grant program.

24.description: The committee directed Bird Friendly Saskatoon to apply for the city's Environmental Grant Program for funding, rather than receiving direct support from this committee, to avoid double-dipping.

chips.text: Staff clarified that receiving funds from both sources would be considered "double dipping."
Bird Friendly Saskatoon sought $3,800 to continue a coordinator position.
David Forbes, Bird Friendly Saskatoon, requested $3,800 for a coordinator.
The organization promotes naturalized areas and public education for bird-friendly urban spaces.

7.description: The committee began drafting the 2026 work plan, focusing on environmental leadership, sustainable growth, and quality of life, to be finalized by March.

chips.text: A question about 'research planetary boundary' was raised.
The draft work plan will be submitted to the Standing Policy Committee.

9.description: The Committee maintained a $7,800 budget allocation for committee member education and training in 2026, keeping it as a flexible placeholder despite no training being attended last year.

chips.text: The budget is an initial idea, not cast in stone.

21.description: Saskatoon's Community Advisory Committee approved members for its Education and Water Conservation subcommittees, which support the committee's annual work plan.

chips.text: Councillor Ian noted committees are easier to activate when needed than form new.
All voting members of the Community Advisory Committee are eligible.
Robin and Monby committed to co-chair the Education subcommittee.
